title: Capture and Destructure with At
goal: Test a score range while binding the score to a variable name.
hints: Use the @ symbol to bind a name to the value while testing a range pattern.
A fallback arm with an if guard cannot satisfy compiler exhaustiveness.
explanation: `s @ 90..=100` binds `s` to the score if it falls within the range. Writing `s if 90..=100` puts a range into an `if` guard, failing with `E0308` because guards require a boolean. Adding an `if` guard to the second arm leaves numbers over 100 uncovered, failing exhaustiveness with `E0004`.
